title: World Generator: Inject Qualifying T4 Social Events at Controlled Frequency
objective: Make get_world_snapshot return WorldSnapshot instances with a non-None social_event field on a controlled, low-frequency, deterministic schedule in the fallback path, so that the T4 event-aware detection seam (_detect_qualifying_t4_social_event) can trigger during real multi-day simulation runs rather than remaining permanently dormant.
exact_scope: Two files require changes. (1) back/app/world/generator.py: define a two-entry list of pre-built qualifying SocialEventSpec objects (one confrontation, one withdrawal). In _fallback_snapshot(), inject a qualifying event when world_day % 7 == 0, selecting the event type deterministically via cycle_iteration % 2. In _snapshot_from_phase(), pass phase.social_event through to the WorldSnapshot constructor so arc phases that carry a social_event have it propagated. (2) back/tests/test_p32_t2_world_generator_social_event.py: write a test module verifying the injection frequency, determinism, schema validity, arc propagation, and end-to-end detection in a multi-day simulation run. No other files require modification for this task.

context.target_frequency: ~1 qualifying event per 7 fallback days (14%). Trigger condition: world_day % 7 == 0. Deterministic — same day always returns the same event.
context.arc_scope: Injection applies only to the fallback path (days 17+). Arc phases (days 3-16) continue to return social_event=None unless an arc phase explicitly defines one.
context.baseline_audit: P32-T1 (round-0048) confirmed T4 activation rate is zero across a real 10-day simulation of arc days 3-12 where world.social_event is always None.
context.status_note: As of round-0049, the implementation in back/app/world/generator.py is already complete and all 900 tests pass. The task contract documents what was built and the acceptance criteria the reviewer must verify.

constraints: Must not modify back/app/engines/tick_bridge.py — T4 detection seam code is frozen
Must not modify back/app/domain/models.py — AppraisalSignal v1 and SocialEventSpec schema are frozen
Must not modify back/app/domain/enums.py — SocialEventType and related enums are frozen
Must not activate T4 via the old deterministic path (adjusting gates or adversarial branching) — only the social event-aware path is approved
Social events must be deterministic: same world_day always produces the same social_event
Frequency must remain low — at most 1 qualifying event per 7-day window in the fallback path (approximately 14%)
Social event SocialEventSpec fields must only use valid enum values already defined in enums.py
Must not introduce randomness or non-deterministic logic into the generator
Must not extend bridge coverage for deferred ticks T3, T5, T6, T7, T8
Arc days 3-16 must continue to return social_event=None from get_world_snapshot (those arc phases do not define social_event)
acceptance_criteria: get_world_snapshot(21) returns a WorldSnapshot with social_event.event_type in {confrontation, withdrawal} (21 % 7 == 0)
get_world_snapshot(28) returns a WorldSnapshot with social_event.event_type in {confrontation, withdrawal} (28 % 7 == 0)
get_world_snapshot(17) returns a WorldSnapshot with social_event == None (17 % 7 == 3, not a qualifying day)
get_world_snapshot(20) returns a WorldSnapshot with social_event == None (20 % 7 == 6, not a qualifying day)
A scan of days 17-37 yields at least 2 qualifying days and no more than 1 qualifying event in any 7-consecutive-day window
Arc days 3-16 all return social_event=None (arc phases do not define social_event)
Calling get_world_snapshot(N) twice for the same N returns the same social_event value both times
All 900+ existing tests continue to pass with no regressions to T1/T2 continuity, residual persistence, tick bridge mapping, or settlement contracts
test_p32_t2_world_generator_social_event.py passes with all test classes green
required_tests: Every WorldSnapshot produced by get_world_snapshot for fallback days 17-37 must be a valid Pydantic model with correct worldDay, non-empty headlineNews, and a list publicFeedPool.
At least 2 days in the range 17-37 must carry a social_event with event_type confrontation or withdrawal.
Every social_event injected in days 17-37 must be of type confrontation or withdrawal — no other event types may appear.
No 7-consecutive-day window within days 17-37 may contain more than 5 qualifying social events (low-frequency guard).
Calling get_world_snapshot with the same day number twice must return the identical social_event value both times.

On the known qualifying day 21 (21 % 7 == 0), calling get_world_snapshot three times in a row must return a non-None social_event with all four fields (event_type, intensity, reciprocity, expectedness) populated each time.
For arc days where the ArcPhase.social_event is None, the returned WorldSnapshot must also have social_event equal to None.
Every non-None social_event in the fallback range must be a valid SocialEventSpec instance accepted by Pydantic without error.
A 14-day simulation run starting at day 17 must include at least one day where world.social_event carries a qualifying T4 event type.
A 10-day scan of days 17-26 must include at least one qualifying day (day 21 is the first).
non_goals: Routing or filtering of social events based on social_event.target_id
Expanding T4 to produce residuals with aftershock_days > 0 — later phase concern
Creating new SocialEventType values or a richer event taxonomy
Redesigning the world arc narrative structure or adding new arcs
Modifying the settlement engine or appraisal output schema
Activating deferred ticks T3, T5, T6, T7, T8
Injecting qualifying social events into arc days 3-16
